cd /testbed && python -c "
import numpy as np
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.separable import separability_matrix, is_separable

print('=' * 80)
print('Testing separability_matrix with nested CompoundModels')
print('=' * 80)

# Test 1: Simple compound model
print('\n1. Simple compound model (Linear1D & Linear1D):')
cm = m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
print(f'   Model: {cm}')
print(f'   n_inputs: {cm.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm.n_outputs}')
sep_matrix = separability_matrix(cm)
print(f'   Separability matrix:\n{sep_matrix}')

# Test 2: More complex model
print('\n2. More complex model (Pix2Sky_TAN & Linear1D & Linear1D):')
cm2 = m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
print(f'   Model: {cm2}')
print(f'   n_inputs: {cm2.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm2.n_outputs}')
sep_matrix2 = separability_matrix(cm2)
print(f'   Separability matrix:\n{sep_matrix2}')

# Test 3: Nested compound models - THE ISSUE
print('\n3. Nested compound models (Pix2Sky_TAN & (Linear1D & Linear1D)):')
cm3 = m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm
print(f'   Model: {cm3}')
print(f'   n_inputs: {cm3.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm3.n_outputs}')
sep_matrix3 = separability_matrix(cm3)
print(f'   Separability matrix:\n{sep_matrix3}')

# Test 4: Check if both should be the same
print('\n4. Comparing cm2 and cm3:')
print(f'   Are separability matrices equal? {np.array_equal(sep_matrix2, sep_matrix3)}')
if not np.array_equal(sep_matrix2, sep_matrix3):
    print('   BUG: They should be equal but they are not!')

# Test 5: Check is_separable for the nested case
print('\n5. is_separable results:')
print(f'   cm2 (flat): {is_separable(cm2)}')
print(f'   cm3 (nested): {is_separable(cm3)}')
